svg.text: Fig. 1 — Simplified outline of Japan's four main islands with major cities

<tspan x="615" y="182">Japan is an island country in East Asia, located in the</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="202">Pacific Ocean. It comprises an archipelago of nearly</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="222">6,852 islands, with the four largest — Honshū, Hokkaidō,</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="242">Kyūshū, and Shikoku — accounting for roughly 97% of</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="262">the total land area of 377,975 km².</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="290">With a population of approximately 124 million people,</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="310">Japan is the eleventh most populous country and one</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="330">of the world's most densely populated nations. The</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="350">Greater Tokyo Area alone is home to over 37 million</tspan> <tspan x="615" y="370">residents, the most populous metropolitan area on Earth.</tspan>

<tspan x="75" y="542">Japan's economy is the world's fourth-largest by nominal GDP and the fifth-largest by purchasing power parity. A highly developed free-market economy,</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="562">it is known for its advanced technology, automotive industry, electronics, and precision manufacturing. Japan is a member of the G7, G20, and OECD, and</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="582">maintains its position despite challenges including a declining population, aging demographics, and fluctuating exchange rates that have impacted its GDP</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="602">measured in US dollars.</tspan>

<tspan x="75" y="716">Japan's nominal GDP has shown relative stability</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="736">over the past decade, hovering around $4–5 trillion</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="756">in current US dollars. The country reached its peak</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="776">in the period 2018–2021, with GDP approaching</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="796">$5.1 trillion. However, the sharp depreciation of</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="816">the yen against the US dollar in 2022 and 2023</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="836">caused a notable decline in dollar-denominated</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="856">GDP, even as the domestic economy continued to</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="876">grow modestly in real terms.</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="904">Key sectors include automotive manufacturing</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="924">(Toyota, Honda, Nissan), electronics (Sony,</tspan> <tspan x="75" y="944">Panasonic), and financial services.</tspan>

Six essential destinations for first-time visitors

g.text: Shibuya, Akihabara, Senso-ji Temple, Skytree, world-class dining.
Fushimi Inari, Kinkaku-ji, Arashiyama bamboo, 2,000+ temples.
Dotonbori, Osaka Castle, street food capital, vibrant nightlife.
Peace Memorial Park, iconic floating torii gate of Itsukushima Shrine.
Japan's highest peak (3,776 m), hot springs, Lake Ashi views.
Sapporo, Niseko skiing, Furano lavender fields, fresh seafood.
